description: Gives an approximate shipping volume in cubic metres (CBM) for goods from China from their total gross weight and product type. Use it when the buyer knows the weight but not the CBM. Approximate idea only: if the buyer has the exact CBM from the supplier (packing list), that should be used instead.

cartons.description: Optional number of cartons; improves the estimate

hs_code.description: Optional Indian HS code (2 to 8 digits) to help pick the product category

product.description: Product name or type, e.g. office chairs, LED lights, garments, bluetooth speakers

name: estimate_cbm_from_weight
title: Estimate shipment volume (CBM) from weight
